text_span: we employ qGANs to learn and load a model for the spot price of an asset underlying a European call option.
rationale: Introduces the financial application demonstrated in the paper.

rationale: States the modeling assumption used for the finance example.

text_span: we also execute the learning and loading method for a random initialization on an actual quantum computer, the IBM Q Boeblingen 20 qubit chip.

code_label: Training on hardware required fewer epochs
text_span: To improve the robustness of the training against the noise introduced by the quantum hardware, we set the optimizer’s learning rate to 10−3.
rationale: Describes a hardware-specific training adjustment.

code_label: Need for better hardware to run QAE directly
text_span: To be able to run QAE on a quantum computer, further improvements are required, e.g., longer coherence times and higher gate ﬁdelities.
rationale: Explicitly identifies hardware improvements needed for direct execution.

code_label: Polynomial loading versus exponential exact loading
text_span: In contrast to this, current state-of-the-art techniques for exact loading of generic random distributions into an n-qubit state necessitate O 2n ð Þ gates
rationale: Reiterates the central complexity comparison supporting the method.

code_label: Model flexibility through qubits and depth
text_span: The model is ﬂexible because it can be ﬁtted to the complexity of the underlying data and the loading scheme’s resolution can be traded off
rationale: Summarizes a key design tradeoff of the approach.

text_span: qGANs are compatible with online or incremental learning, i.e., the model can be updated if new training data samples become available.
rationale: Notes an additional capability and potential practical benefit.

code_label: Open questions on architectures and strategies
text_span: Some questions remain open and may be subject to future research, for example, an analysis of optimal quantum generator and discriminator structures as well as training strategies.
rationale: Explicitly states unresolved research questions.

code_label: Barren plateaus not observed but possible
text_span: although barren plateaus45 were not observed in our experiments, the possible occurrence of this effect, as well as counteracting methods, should be investigated.
rationale: Acknowledges a potential training issue and calls for further study.

code_label: Continuous or non-equidistant data remains open
text_span: it might be interesting to look into the compatibility of qGANs with continuous or non-equidistantly distributed values.
